gaps.title: Fake PDF Export implementation
gaps.jtbd: When a client downloads the dossier report, I want to receive a valid PDF file containing the compiled dossier data, so that I can view and store it according to the requested export requirements.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a generated dossier report
When the client calls GET /api/v1/dossier/reports/{id}/download
Then the system should generate and return a valid PDF document containing the document data instead of casting plaintext bytes as application/pdf.
gaps.reason: The original brief explicitly requested 'Экспорт сводного документа в единый PDF-файл.' (Export of the summary document into a single PDF file). The current implementation in EmployeeDossierController casts a plaintext string to bytes and serves it as APPLICATION_PDF, which will result in a corrupted/invalid PDF file for users.

gaps.title: Missing pagination for dossier documents search
gaps.jtbd: When searching for employee documents, I want the results to be paginated, so that the application performs efficiently even with thousands of documents.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a large dataset of employee documents
When the client calls GET /api/v1/dossier/documents
Then the results should be paginated (e.g. using 'page' and 'size' parameters) rather than returning the entire dataset at once.
gaps.reason: Domain-standard expectation. The search endpoint for employee documents currently returns a full, unpaginated list (`List<EmployeeDocument>`). In standard document management or analytical systems, any listing endpoint, especially one allowing filters, requires pagination to prevent memory overflow and ensure acceptable response times.
